description: This file defines database triggers for synchronizing full-text search tables ('content_fts' and 'notes_fts') with changes in 'content' and 'notes' tables within the Notesnook project. It includes functions to create and drop triggers that handle insert, delete, and update events.

methods.name: createTriggers
methods.description: Creates database triggers for content and notes tables to update full-text search tables upon insert, delete, and update events.

methods.name: dropTriggers
methods.description: Drops the previously created triggers for content and notes tables.
